$description: Coverly ROMs design tokens (W3C DTCG 2025.10). Source of truth for the app (src/styles) and landing (site/assets). Brand: "Buckram & Manila". Generated by build_brand.py; CSS is emitted as RGB channels + hex, oklch only inside @supports.

light.$description: Semantic roles, light theme. CSS: --cr-<role>. Applies to :root.

legacy-light.$description: Existing --cr-* names kept working (light). Aliases to semantic roles.

shadcn-light.$description: shadcn/ui names (light). tailwind.config maps e.g. primary -> rgb(var(--cr-primary) / <alpha-value>). Note: shadcn "accent" is the neutral hover fill, NOT the brand accent (legacy --cr-accent = primary).

dark.$description: Semantic roles, dark theme. CSS: --cr-<role>. Applies to :root[data-theme=dark] and prefers-color-scheme: dark.

legacy-dark.$description: Existing --cr-* names kept working (dark). Aliases to semantic roles.

shadcn-dark.$description: shadcn/ui names (dark). tailwind.config maps e.g. primary -> rgb(var(--cr-primary) / <alpha-value>). Note: shadcn "accent" is the neutral hover fill, NOT the brand accent (legacy --cr-accent = primary).

icon.$description: App icon body corner on the 1024 canvas (824 body).

duration.$description: Collapse all to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

spring.$description: Playful only (tag drop, hover). Never on apply/destructive.
